hints.title: Total Sum Formulation
hints.text: Notice that right_sum = total_sum - left_sum, so score = left_sum - right_sum = 2 * left_sum - total_sum.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Tracking
hints.text: Maintain a running left_sum as you iterate from index 0 to n - 2.

hints.title: Maximize Left Sum
hints.text: Since total_sum is fixed, maximizing 2 * left_sum - total_sum is equivalent to finding the maximum left_sum across all valid cut positions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maxSplitScore(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        total_sum = sum(nums)
        left_sum = 0
        max_score = float('-inf')
        
        for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
            left_sum += nums[i]
            right_sum = total_sum - left_sum
            max_score = max(max_score, left_sum - right_sum)
        
        return max_score
```

complexity.notes: Single pass prefix accumulation with constant extra space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing slice sums sum(nums[:i+1]) and sum(nums[i+1:]) inside the loop takes quadratic O(n^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects single pass linear scan avoiding repeated slice sum calculations.
